versions.content: End of Interval: Last Context Data If the SEv is forwarded to the next filter in the filter chain and if IdsMContextDataSourceSelector equals IDSM_FILTERS_CTX_USE_LAST, then the context data shall equal the last context data of an SEv of given type that has been received at the aggregation filter in the past time interval.
